subject.title: message tool should auto-select the only enabled account

question: Should omitted message-tool account IDs infer a single enabled configured account after explicit/default/bound precedence, or should OpenClaw keep requiring explicit `accountId` or `defaultAccount` when the configured default is disabled?
rationale: The implementation boundary is clear, but the behavior changes fallback semantics for existing multi-account configurations and needs maintainer acceptance before the linked PR or a replacement can land.

options.title: Accept shared resolver policy
options.body: Land or replace the linked PR with a shared resolver that uses enabled/configured account state and fails clearly for zero or multiple enabled accounts.

options.title: Keep explicit account selection
options.body: Keep current semantics and document that users must pass `accountId` or configure `defaultAccount` when the default account is disabled.

options.title: Require channel-owned fallback
options.body: Ask for channel-owned behavior if maintainers do not want core to own this inference policy across message channels.

recommendation.title: Accept shared resolver policy
recommendation.body: Land or replace the linked PR with a shared resolver that uses enabled/configured account state and fails clearly for zero or multiple enabled accounts.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already supplied the prior shared-resolver direction and is the clearest available owner for the fallback-policy decision.
